Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step plan (no function calls executed yet)

1. Establish the outer volume  
   • Use functions.block once with subtraction = False.  
   • Base point (0, 0, 0).  
   • Dimensions: x_size = 220 mm, y_size = 300 mm, z_size = 160 mm.  
   Result: a full solid whose outside size equals the requested box size.

2. Carve the interior cavity to create the walls and bottom  
   • Use functions.block a second time with subtraction = True.  
   • Offset (wall thickness, wall thickness, bottom thickness) = (8, 8, 12) mm.  
   • Cavity dimensions:  
     x_size = 220 – 2·8 = 204 mm  
     y_size = 300 – 2·8 = 284 mm  
     z_size = 160 – 12 = 148 mm  
   This subtraction removes all material inside the box, right up to the top, while leaving an 8 mm-thick wall on all four sides and a 12 mm-thick bottom.

3. Nothing else is required; no cylinders or forces are involved.  

When you tell me to proceed, I will prepare one call to functions.block that contains both blocks (the outer solid first, the inner cavity second) and finish with functions.finished.

Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once
